# LobeHub

> > LobeHub is an AI agent collaboration platform where you can discover, build, and deploy intelligent agents with multimodal workflow automation.

LobeHub provides a comprehensive marketplace and development environment for AI agents, featuring integrations with ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek-OCR, and MCP (Model Context Protocol). The platform offers agent skills, workflow automation, knowledge base management, and a complete design system through Lobe UI, Icons, Charts, and TTS components.

## Key Topics

- AI Agents
- Agent Marketplace
- Agent Builder
- MCP (Model Context Protocol)
- DeepSeek-OCR
- ChatGPT
- Multimodal Workflow Automation
- Skills Integration
- Knowledge Base (RAG)
- Lobe UI Design System
- Agent Collaboration
- Image Generation
- Workflow Automation
- OIDC Authentication
- ZenMux
